verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance's Account Owner Verification product retrieves name, address, email and phone on file at the connected financial institution. It also offers a dedicated match endpoint that returns confidence scores comparing your customer data against the bank-provided ownership details, which covers the matching goal directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on how often contact fields are unavailable ('where available').

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer

citations.quote: Retrieves account ownership details (name, address, email and phone - where available) from a connected account at a financial institution.

you can send customer data to our match account ownership details endpoint to receive confidence scores comparing the provided data and the account ownership details provided by a financial institution
